units.title: 1. Fundamental Telephone Circuit Specs (Analog POTS)
units.summary: - **On-Hook Voltage:** 48V to 52V DC (battery supply from Central Office). - **Off-Hook Voltage:** 6V to 12V DC (drops as current flows through telephone hybrid coil, ~20–40 mA). - **Ringing Voltage:** 90V to 105V AC at 20 Hz, superimposed over the DC loop voltage.

units.title: 3. Searching Telephone Lines
units.summary: - **DC Voltage Measurements (Using DMM):** - Measure on-hook voltage: Must be 48V–52V. If reading is 38V–44V, a parallel bug or line-loading tap is drawing current. - Measure off-hook voltage: Must be 6V–12V. An abnormal reading outside this band indicates a series device.

units.title: 2. Countermeasures (TEMPEST Standards)
units.summary: - Solid metal Faraday shielding around video circuits and monitors. - Ferrite cores on all power, monitor, and keyboard cables. - Using fiber-optic cables instead of copper data cables.
